name: Academic
description:
You are learned in many scholarly matters.
Your proficiency level in three of Arcana, Crafting, History, Nature, Society or a Lore skill increases (max Expert).

name: Alert
description:
With a watchful eye you are ready for danger.
Your proficiency level in Perception increases (max Expert).
You can choose to roll initiative with your Perception score instead of your DEX.

name: Always The Right Tool
description:
You always seem to have the correct tool in your pocket.
Once per day, as a two action activity you may find a small tool, gear, ammunition or material you could have bought earlier in your bags.
You then reveal when you bought the item and pay for them.
You have one more quick access slot.

name: Army Training
description:
You have served in one of the armies, and trained with its equipment.
You become trained in Light Armor and two weapon groups depending on the army:
Draconic Legions. Polearms and Runeguns.
Thezan Armies. Swords and Runeguns.
Spellshield Formations. Shields and Swords.
El-Shavrian Armies. Swords and Crossbows.
Yirte Militias. Bows and Knives.

name: Athlete
description:
You've trained your body.
Increase the distance you can move without making a check when you take the Leap or High Jump action by 2 tiles.
Your proficiency level in Athletics or Acrobatics increases (max Expert).

name: Battlefield Medic
description:
You've trained to practice medicine even in the heat of combat.
Your proficiency level in medicine or athletics increases (max Expert). 
You can spend a focus point to take the Treat Wounds action as a single action.

name: Calculate The Odds
description:
You take a moment to think and calculate your next move.
You learn the Calculate The Odds action.
You can use this a number of times per day equal to your INT.

name: Combat Training
description:
You have seen combat or trained in an army.
Your proficiency level in Fortitude saves increases (max Trained).
You become trained in one weapon group of your choice.

name: Dedicated Student
description:
You have focused on practicing magic above all else.
Gain one level 1 Arcane Feat.

name: Defensive Training
description:
You've trained your defense.
Your proficiency level in one type of saving throws increases (max Trained). 
You may choose this feat multiple times.

name: Duelist
description:
Your experience has you always ready for combat.
When you roll initiative, you may Strike, Cast a Spell that costs 1 action, or Step as a free action.
If you critically hit a creature with an attack or a spell that only targets them, they get a -1 penalty on D20 rolls until the start of your next turn.

name: Encouraging Words
description:
You may attempt to shake your allies out of fright.
You have the Snap Out of It action
Your proficiency level in Persuasion increases (max Expert).

name: Expert Pilot
description:
Your skill in piloting vehicles is well known.
Your proficiency level in Airship Lore, Ship Lore or Land Vehicles Lore increases (max Expert).
You count as two people when it comes to operating a vehicle.

name: Heavy Armor Training
description:
Unlike most mages you have experience in fighting in heavy armor. 
You are trained with heavy armor.

name: Inspiring Leader
description:
You have a way with words and can inspire those around you.
You can use the Inspire Courage action once per day.
Your proficiency level in Persuasion or Warfare Lore increases (max Expert).

name: Item Thrower
description:
You are good at throwing items and gadgets, and can land them in ways that others cannot.
The range you can throw items, gadgets and potions increases by 3 tiles.
Additionally, you may attempt a Sleight of Hand check to bounce thrown items around corners or through small openings.

name: Linguist
description:
You know how to speak with people and master any language you come across.
Learn two extra languages.
You have advantage on checks to decipher languages.
Your proficiency level in Society or Persuasion increases (max Expert).

name: Lore Mastery
description:
There is one type of lore that you know better than almost anyone.
Choose one Lore skill to become Expert in.
At level 5 you become Master in the chosen lore.
At level 12 you become Legendary in it.

name: Marksman
description:
You've trained in the art of aiming and shooting. 
You learn the Aim technique.
You don't take a penalty when attacking with runeguns or crossbows while prone.
prerequisites: Trained with at least one type of ranged weapons

name: Martial Arts Training
description:
You know how to fight unarmed, from time spent scrapping or formal martial arts training.
You become trained with unarmed attacks.
Your unarmed attacks use a one-step-larger die (1d2 → 1d4 → 1d6 → 1d8).
Your proficiency level in Brawling increases one step (max Expert).

name: Martial Gun Arts
description:
You've learned to fight in close range with your firearm.
You can use runeguns as melee weapons, dealing 1d4 bludgeoning damage or 1d6 if you are holding them in two hands.
You no longer take a penalty to attacks with bayonets.

name: Nerves of Steel
description:
You let nothing scare you.
Your proficiency level in Will saves increases (max Trained).
You have advantage on Will saves against fear effects.

name: Opportunist
description:
You're good at striking enemies when a moment of opportunity appears.
Your penalty on Reactive Strikes is reduced by 2 (-1 without an agile weapon, 0 with one).

name: Quick Witted
description:
You're good at quickly coming up with comebacks and retorts.
If another creature fails to intimidate or persuade you, you may intimidate or persuade them as a reaction.
Your proficiency level in Intimidation or Persuasion increases (max Expert).

name: Quip
description:
You've learned to banter and quip in the middle of battle to distract your enemies.
You have the Quip action.
Your proficiency level in Persuasion increases (max Expert).

name: Skilled
description:
You have practiced three skills of your choice.
Your proficiency level in the three skills increases (max Expert).
You may choose this feat multiple times.

name: Skilled Combatant
description:
You've learned some manuevers to improve your tactical fighting.
You learn three simple techniques.

name: Sneaky
description:
You can move silently and hide in shadows.
When sneaking, you can move at full speed while remaining in stealth.
Your proficiency level in the Stealth increases (max Expert).

name: Staff Training
description:
You have trained with staves, a traditional weapon for mages.
You are trained with the staff weapon group.
You can turn wood into a battlestaff or longstaff during a short rest.
If you have the Shape Metal spell you can use it to create a battlestaff as a three-action activity.

name: Surveyor
description:
You have studied maps and the land, learning how to read the terrain.
Your proficiency level in Geography Lore increases (max Expert).
Your exploration speed is two steps faster than what it would normally be.
You can always find north.

name: Survivor
description:
You have survived against the elements.
You gain resistance 3 to one type of elemental damage: fire, cold, electricity, acid or thunder. 
You have a +3 bonus on Survival Checks to avoid natural hazards and extreme weather.
Your proficiency level in Survival or Perception increases (max Expert).

name: Tactical Combatant
description:
You can make the best of the heat of combat.
Your proficiency level in Warfare Lore increases (max Expert).
You have the Combat Assessment technique.

name: Underhanded Striker
description:
You know how to strike opponents when they're weakened.
When you attack an opponent that is off-guard you deal 1d6 more damage.
Alternatively, you may reduce the Targeted attack penalty against such opponents by 2 (to a minimum of 1).

name: Untrained Improvisation
description:
You are used to improvising and getting into novel scenarios.
You have a +1 bonus to all (non-Lore) skills you are untrained in.

name: Weapons Training
description:
You have trained in a variety of weapons.
Become trained in two weapon groups of your choice.
Instead of picking a weapon group you may pick all Simple Weapons or a single Advanced Weapon.
You may choose this feat multiple times.

name: Will to Live
description:
Taking you down is harder than most, and you don't stay down.
You may add your PHY or WIL to death saving throws.
When you would be critically hit, you may spend a focus point to add your PHY or WIL to the save, potentially reducing it to a normal hit.

name: You're Next
description:
You know the perfect line for when you defeat your foes.
When you kill or defeat a foe you may use your reaction to use Intimidate.
Your proficiency level in Intimidation increases (max Expert).

name: Aerialist
description:
The sky is your calling.
When you have a flight or glide speed it increases by 1.
You have a +2 bonus to any Acrobatics or Athletics check you make in the air.

name: Bob and Weave
description:
You've learned how to dodge blows in the thick of it.
Your proficiency level in Reflex saving throws increases (max Trained).
When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you gain a +1 bonus to saving throws against them until the start of your next turn.

name: Emergency Aura Block
description:
Your experience with danger allows you to shield yourself with your aura, even before you're aware of the threat.
Once per hour you may Aura Block as a free action.

name: Focused
description:
Your focus is steady, even in battle.
Increase your focus pool amount by 1.

name: Like Shooting Fish in a Barrel
description:
You can keep reloading as you deal with your foes.
Once per turn, when you kill or knock out a creature, you may reload an held weapon as a free action.

name: Skilled Fencer
description:
You've trained in the arts of fencing.
You have a +1 bonus when Parrying.
You learn the Cut Down Projectile and Riposte techniques.

name: Advanced Weapon Fighter
description:
You've always been fascinated with unique, advanced weapons.
Your proficiency level with one advanced weapon increases (max Trained).
When you would increase your proficiency with that weapon group, include the chosen weapon.
Your proficiency level with Warfare Lore or Crafting increases (max Trained).

name: Armor Expertise
description:
You know how to make the most of your armor.
When wearing armor the resistances it grants increase by 1, or 2 if it's heavy armor.
Additionally, when wearing heavy armor with gauntlets, your unarmed attacks deal 1d4 bludgeoning damage.

name: Strike The Unwary
description:
You're always taking every opportunity to strike your foes.
You can use Reactive Strikes on creatures casting spells with somatic components, and on actions with the Manipulate trait.

name: Always Ready
description:
You are always ready.
When you roll initiative and aren't surprised, you may add your INT or WIL to your roll.
Your proficiency level in Perception or Insight increases (max Master).

name: Commanding Presence
description:
Your strong mind steadies your allies.
Your proficiency level in Will saves increases (max Expert).
Allied creatures within 6 tiles have a +1 bonus to their Will saves.

name: Evasion Expertise
description:
You know how to evade even wide area attacks.
Your proficiency level in Reflex saves increases (max Expert).
When you get a success on a Reflex save, you may use your reaction to turn it into a critical success.

name: Expert Brawler
description:
Brawling comes to you naturally.
Your proficiency level in Brawling increases (max Expert).
Your proficiency level in unarmed attacks increases (max Expert).
You learn two simple or advanced techniques with the Brawling trait.

name: Fleet
description:
You've trained to be faster than most.
Your move speed increases by 1.

name: Magical Master
description:
You've focused even more on your magical skills.
Gain one level 6 Arcane Feat.

name: Martial Expertise
description:
Your martial experience has only increased with time.
Your proficiency level in two weapon groups increases (max Expert).
You may learn a simple or advanced technique instead of picking a weapon group.
You may choose this feat multiple times.

name: Move Together
description:
You move together with your companion.
When you Stride you may have your golem, soulbond or other familiar Stride in the same direction.
prerequisites: You have a golem, soulbond or other familiar

name: Perfect Condition
description:
You always keep your body in a healthy state.
Increase your health by your PHY.
Your proficiency level in Fortitude saving throws increases (max Expert).

name: Rolling Landing
description:
You can land on your feet like a cat.
You learn the Cat Fall reaction.
Your proficiency level in Acrobatics increases (max Master).

name: Scrappy Survivalist
description:
Though you may not be physically imposing, you've learned to survive.
Increase your health by 5.
Your proficiency level in Fortitude saves increases (max Expert).

name: Sharpshooter
description:
You're an expert ranged combatant.
Your proficiency level in the Bows, Crossbows or Runegun weapon groups increases (max Expert).
You learn the Sharpshooter's Stance action.

name: Spot Weak Point
description:
Your knowlegde in medicine allows you to spot weak points on creatures.
You have the Spot Weak Point action.
Your proficiency level in Medicine increases (max Master).

name: Tactician
description:
You lead with strategic insight in combat encounters.
When you roll initiative you may swap your place in initiative with a willing ally.
You learn two simple or advanced techniques with the Tactical trait.

name: Titan Grappler
description:
You've grappled with bigger monsters.
Your proficiency level in Brawling increases (max Master).
You count as one size bigger when determining penalties and bonuses from grappling.

name: Battlefield Awareness
description:
Taking you off guard is harder than most.
Your proficiency level in Perception increases (max Master).
While off-guard, you reduce the penalty by 1.

name: Defensive Duelist
description:
Nothing can get past your guard.
Your bonus when parrying increases to +2.
When you succeed on a Parry, you get a +1 bonus on your next attack until the end of your next turn (stacks up to 3 times).

name: Flash Of Genius
description:
Your mind works at a greater speed.
Once per turn you may spend a focus point to reduce action cost of an action with the Mental trait by 1.
Your proficiency level in Arcana, Nature, History or a Lore Skill increases (max Master).

name: Impactful Strikes
description:
Your strikes carry enough weight to impact creatures through armor.
Your melee strikes ignore physical resistances up to half your PHY, or your full PHY if you use a two-handed weapon.

name: In The Thick of It
description:
You fight the best while in the midst of combat.
If you start your turn adjacent to 2 or more enemies, gain a temporary focus point that lasts until the end of your turn.

name: Second Wind
description:
You take a breath and let energy return to you.
Once per day, you spend an action to lose one level of exhaustion and get back a focus point.

name: Shield Specialization
description:
You know how to use shields to their fullest extent.
Your proficiency level with shields is Expert.
While you are holding a buckler you may cast spells as normal with that hand.
You learn two simple or advanced techniques with the Defensive trait.

name: Strike Together
description:
You attack together with your companion.
When you Strike you may have your golem, soulbond or other familiar strike the same target.
prerequisites: You have a golem, soulbond or other familiar

name: Rapid Striker
description:
You have trained to rapidly strike targets without error.
Your multiple attack penalty is 1 lower per step (-4 normally, -3 with agile weapons).

name: Versatile Wielder
description:
You're ready to fight with whatever weapon comes your way.
Your proficiency level with all weapons and improvised attacks is Expert.

name: Bloodthirsty
description:
You hunger for the thrill of battle.
The first time each turn you get a critical hit with a melee Strike, gain 1 focus point.

name: Instinctive Aura Block
description:
Using your aura to shield yourself comes naturally to you after this many battles.
Once per turn you may Aura Block as a free action.

name: Master Sprinter
description:
You can run so fast you sprint across liquids
Your move speed increases by 1.
When you Stride you can move across water and liquids. 
If you end your turn on the surface of a liquid you fall.

name: Weapon Master
description:
Mastery at arms.
Your proficiency level in a weapon group increases (max Master).
You learn two simple, advanced or complex techniques.
You may choose this feat multiple times.

name: Blade Artist
description:
You've learned to do the impossible with your weapon.
You learn one Blade Art technique.
Increase your focus pool by 1.

name: Parrying Master
description:
You feel ready to take on the world with a blade in your hand.
Your bonus when parrying melee attacks increases to +3.
While Parrying you have an extra reaction.

name: Legendary Weapon Master
description:
Your skill with weapons is legendary.
Your proficiency level in a weapon group increases (max Legendary).
You learn one technique of any level.
You may choose this feat multiple times.

name: Mythic Champion
description:
Your training and experience allows you to repeatedly go beyond normal limits.
Blade Arts cost one less focus point for you.
You learn two more Blade Art techniques.
